name: Actor searches for product that doesn't exist
scenarioId: classpath:features/product_catalog:Actor searches for product that doesn't exist
methodName: Actor searches for product that doesn't exist

testSteps.description: Given Actor is on the home page
Then no products should be displayed
And the message "There are no products found." should be displayed

userStory.narrative:
As a customer,
  I want to easily search, filter, and sort products in the catalog
  So that I can find what I need quickly

title: Actor searches for product that doesn't exist

rule.name: Customer should be able to search for products by name
